errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 8 characters

login.title: Log in to your account
login.lead: See your booked visits and reschedule or cancel them.
login.rememberDescription: Leave it off on a shared computer — the session then ends when you close the tab.
login.noAccount: No account yet? It takes two minutes.
login.failedTitle: The email or password does not match
login.failedMessage: Check the email and type the password again.
login.errorMessage: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.

register.title: Create an account
register.lead: We create an account so you can book visits and see them in one place. It takes under two minutes.
register.name: Full name
register.phoneHint: We send confirmations and reminders to this number.
register.terms: I accept the terms of use
register.termsDescription: Includes the rules for cancelling up to 12 hours before the visit.
register.gdpr: I agree my health data may be processed for the purpose of the visit
register.gdprDescription: Only the clinician and the clinic team have access.
register.emailTakenMessage: Log in to your account or use another address.

appointments.errorTitle: We could not load the appointments
appointments.errorText: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.

cancel.title: Cancel this visit?
cancel.text: The time is freed straight away and someone else can book it. There is no undo.
cancel.whichFor: You are cancelling the visit of {{patient}} — <mono>{{when}}</mono>.
cancel.lateText: This close to the visit, cancelling goes through reception.
cancel.lateCall: Call <mono>{{phone}}</mono> and we will sort it out.
cancel.forbiddenMessage: You can only cancel your own visits.
cancel.failedMessage: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.

triage.privacy: Only the clinician and the clinic team see these answers.

pain.question: How bad is the pain right now?
pain.help: One means barely noticeable, ten the worst you can imagine.

duration.question: How long have you had it?

temperature.question: Do you have a temperature?
temperature.help: Above 37.5 °C, measured in the last 24 hours.

swelling.question: Is there any swelling?
swelling.help: At the site of the complaint or around it.

page.title: A few questions about your complaint
page.lead: Under a minute. Your answers decide who sees you sooner, which is why they come before the time.
page.leadWithSlot: Under a minute. As soon as you answer, we book you for <mono>{{when}}</mono>.

staffQueue.lead: Triage moved them up, whichever day they fall on. Click one to open its day below.

doctors.title: Choose your clinician
doctors.lead: Pick a clinician to see their available times.
doctors.emptyText: No clinician currently has a public schedule.
doctors.errorTitle: We could not load the clinicians
doctors.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
doctors.signInTitle: Log in to see the times
doctors.signInText: Clinician schedules are open to registered patients only.

calendar.pickPrompt: Pick a free time from the grid.
calendar.bookedNoTriageMessage: The questionnaire did not go through — fill it in from My appointments.
calendar.emptyText: Try next week or pick another clinician.
calendar.errorTitle: We could not load the times
calendar.errorText: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.
calendar.takenMessage: Someone booked it while you were choosing. Pick another.

hero.title: Care without the wait
hero.lead: Answer a few questions about your symptoms, see which clinician at {{clinic}} is free this week, and book in under two minutes.
hero.phone: Or call <mono>{{phone}}</mono> and we will book you in.

doctors.title: Choose your clinician
doctors.lead: Pick a clinician to see their available times.

steps.title: You answer the questions
steps.text: A few questions about your symptoms and pain. It takes under a minute.

steps.title: You see who is free
steps.text: We show the clinicians with open times this week.

steps.title: You book the time
steps.text: The time is yours the moment you confirm — no phone call, no queue.

upcoming.title: Your next visit
upcoming.safety: If you have severe chest pain or trouble breathing right now, call <mono>{{phone}}</mono> instead of booking a visit.

login.title: Log in
login.text: This will hold the email and password form; on success we keep the token and the role (PATIENT / STAFF) and redirect to the matching home screen.

register.title: Create an account
register.text: This is where a patient signs up on their own — name, email, phone and password — so they can book without calling reception.

myAppointments.title: My appointments
myAppointments.lead: The visits you have booked at the clinic.
myAppointments.emptyText: Pick a clinician and book a visit — it takes under two minutes.

doctorAppointments.title: My schedule
doctorAppointments.emptyText: As soon as someone books with you, they will show up here.

doctorSlots.title: Working hours
doctorSlots.lead: Pick a date range and your working hours — we create the slots in 30-minute steps. Existing ones are left untouched.
doctorSlots.rules: Saturdays, Sundays, the 12:00 – 13:00 break and the days off below are all skipped.

errors.dateOrder: The end date is before the start date.
errors.timeOrder: The day must end after it starts.
errors.tooLong: The range can span at most {{days}} days.

doctorSlots.summary: We will create <mono>{{slots}}</mono> slots across <mono>{{days}}</mono> working days.
doctorSlots.emptyText: The range holds no working day at all. Pick another one.
doctorSlots.createdMessage_one: We added {{count}} new slot to your schedule.
doctorSlots.createdMessage_other: We added {{count}} new slots to your schedule.
doctorSlots.noneMessage: Every slot in this range is already in your schedule.
doctorSlots.failedTitle: We could not create the slots
doctorSlots.failedMessage: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.

exceptions.title: Days off
exceptions.lead: The days you do not see patients. No slots are created for them and nobody can book with you.
exceptions.empty: You have no days off marked.
exceptions.hint: Visits already booked for that day stay — get in touch with those patients.
exceptions.errorTitle: We could not load your days off
exceptions.errorText: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.
exceptions.failedTitle: The change did not go through

staffDashboard.title: Staff dashboard
staffDashboard.lead: The day's visits, in time order.
staffDashboard.emptyTitle: No visits booked for this day
staffDashboard.emptyText: Try a neighbouring day or pick a date.

staffNewBooking.title: Booking by phone
staffNewBooking.text: You go through the same steps the patient would: the questions, the doctor, the time. Only the end differs — the slot is held in your name and you then pass it on.
staffNewBooking.holdNote: A held slot is yours until you give it to someone. So while you say "I can give you Tuesday at 10", nobody can take it from you.

staffRoles.title: Roles
staffRoles.lead: You grant rights to someone already registered. Look them up by phone so you know who you are changing before you do it.
staffRoles.phoneHint: We search by the exact number, so pick the country too.
staffRoles.notFoundText: They have to register themselves first — accounts are not created from here.
staffRoles.specialityHint: Patients see this when they pick a doctor.
staffRoles.doneMessage: {{name}} has to sign out and back in for the new rights to apply.
staffRoles.failed: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
staffRoles.note: The role takes effect at the next sign-in — until then the person keeps their old rights.

notFound.title: No such page
notFound.lead: The address you opened does not exist. It may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.
notFound.imageAlt: An eye chart whose top line reads 404, with the lines below it blurring away

appError.title: Something went wrong
appError.lead: This page stopped working. Reloading usually fixes it; if it happens again, please call the front desk.
appError.imageAlt: A stethoscope tied in a knot

staffBooking.heldMessage: It is booked in your name for {{time}}. Now pass it to the patient.

assign.title: Who is this slot for
assign.lead: Look the patient up by phone. If they have no account, we record the slot against a name and phone.
assign.phoneHint: We search by the exact number, so pick the country too.
assign.notFoundText: Record the slot against a name and phone — it stays with you on the dashboard.
assign.name: Full name
assign.releaseHint: If the call does not end in a booking, release it so someone else can see it.
assign.releasedMessage: It is back among the free ones.
assign.failedMessage: Please try again in a moment.
assign.missingTitle: This slot is no longer yours
assign.missingText: It has either been transferred, or the address is wrong.
